title: Experimental Soda Surfaces Workshop
summary: A 2.5-day hands-on soda firing workshop in Provo for potters 18+ with clay experience. Load, fire, and unload the kiln; bring 5-15 bisqued cone 10+ pots. Dates TBD.
commitment: 2.5 days: Day 1 afternoon/evening (2-3 hrs), Day 2 early morning to evening (8-9 hrs), Day 3 early morning (2-3 hrs)
bring: 5-15 bisqued pots (5"x5" or smaller recommended) that fire to cone 10+; optional personal glazes and slips
cost_text: $160.00 USD; includes 5lb clay, propane, glazes, slips, kiln maintenance
how_to_join: Email list signup available for future workshops
source_quote: 2.5-Day High-Fire Experimental Soda Surfaces Workshop... Dates TBD
evidence_sentence: The workshop page describes a 2.5-day hands-on soda firing experience from glazing and wadding to firing and unloading the kiln.
evidence_quote: 2.5-day workshop offers a chance to dive into the high-fire soda process, from glazing and wadding to firing and unloading the kiln
